name: smwblocks-yoshi-s-island-colored-bricks
title: Yoshi's Island Colored Bricks
description:
These blocks are designed to mimic the colored bricks found in Yoshi's Island. (They appear in 4-4, 4-8, and 6-8, as far as I know.) Each color takes a certain number of hits with a thrown sprite to destroy, and they change color when you hit them.

DrAnas update: Converted all blocks to SA-1 and made the tiles and SFX more customizable!
